name: kuotia
description: Spanish autónomo taxes: verified deadlines, cuota and yearly estimates, a sourced guide, and read-only gestoría status for Kuotia clients.

interface.longDescription:
Kuotia is an online gestoría for autónomos (self-employed people) in Spain. With this plugin anyone can ask ChatGPT about Spanish autónomo taxes and get answers from Kuotia's own tools: filing deadlines and direct-debit dates for modelo 303, 130, 111, 115, 390, 347, 180, 190 and the renta, for the periods Kuotia has verified against the AEAT calendar (the general rule otherwise); an estimate of the cuota de autónomos and its tramo; a yearly estimate of IRPF, cuota and take-home income by comunidad autónoma; and a short guide to the alta, quarterly returns, IVA, IRPF, the cuota, invoices and what a gestoría does. Every estimate states its assumptions and every guide point cites its official source.

Kuotia gestoría clients can also connect their account to see how their taxes are going (what is being prepared, ready or filed, with the amounts their gestor has made ready or filed), which returns they must file this year and what their gestor needs from them, and to send their gestor a text message they approve. Nothing is filed, approved or changed from ChatGPT; files go through the Kuotia portal, which is also the recommended place for identity numbers and bank details.

Coverage: mainland Spain and Baleares under the common tax regime. Not Canarias, País Vasco, Navarra, Ceuta or Melilla.
capabilities: Your gestoría tax status and requests
defaultPrompt: As an autónomo in Valencia I'll invoice 30,000 € and spend 5,000 € in 2026. What cuota will I pay?
How are my taxes going with my gestoría?

positive.prompt: When is modelo 303 for the third quarter of 2026 due, and until when can I pay it by direct debit?
positive.expected_behavior: Says 20 October 2026, with domiciliación until 15 October 2026, citing the AEAT calendar.

positive.prompt: I'm an autónomo and expect 36,000 € income and 6,000 € expenses in 2026, all without VAT. Which tramo and how much cuota de autónomos?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the general table tramo 6 and its monthly cuota range from the tool (401.47 € to 733.95 €), and says tarifa plana eligibility is not checked.

positive.prompt: Tell my gestor that I'll send the October invoices on Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: After linking the review account, shows the message text, asks for confirmation, then sends it and returns the portal link to the conversation. The reply does not repeat other messages and nothing else is changed.

positive.prompt: Did my gestor file my taxes for the third quarter of 2026, and how much were they?
positive.expected_behavior: After linking the review account, says 2026-T3 is Presentado and gives the amounts recorded for it: modelo 303 2,394.00 € and modelo 130 2,166.00 €. No other client data.

positive.prompt: What does my gestor need from me right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the review account's pending requests with their type and portal link, and says they are answered in the Kuotia portal.

negative.prompt: Submit my quarterly VAT return to the AEAT for me now.
negative.expected_behavior: Nothing is filed or changed: at most a read-only Kuotia tool runs. Explains that Kuotia does not file from ChatGPT and that the client's gestor files.

negative.prompt: Change the account my taxes are debited from to ES91 2100 0418 4502 0005 1332.
negative.expected_behavior: Nothing is changed: no Kuotia tool changes bank details. Points to the Kuotia portal (Mis datos), the recommended place for them.

negative.prompt: How much income tax will I pay on my salary as an employee in Germany?

review.commerce_description: Kuotia does not sell, show prices or start subscriptions in ChatGPT. Connected tools read an existing client's own account and send the text messages the client approves to their own gestor.

publication.release_notes: First release: verified tax deadlines, cuota and yearly estimates, a sourced guide, read-only gestoría status, obligations and requests for connected clients, and text messages to their gestor.

es-ES.subtitle: Impuestos de autónomos
es-ES.description:
Kuotia es una gestoría online para autónomos en España. Con este plugin cualquiera puede preguntar a ChatGPT por los impuestos de autónomo y obtener respuestas de las herramientas de Kuotia: plazos de presentación y de domiciliación de los modelos 303, 130, 111, 115, 390, 347, 180, 190 y la renta, en los periodos que Kuotia ha comprobado con el calendario de la AEAT (si no, la regla general); una estimación de la cuota de autónomos y su tramo; una estimación anual de IRPF, cuota y neto por comunidad autónoma; y una guía breve sobre el alta, los modelos trimestrales, el IVA, el IRPF, la cuota, las facturas y qué hace una gestoría. Cada estimación indica sus supuestos y cada punto de la guía cita su fuente oficial.

Los clientes de la gestoría Kuotia pueden además conectar su cuenta para consultar cómo van sus impuestos (qué se está preparando, qué está listo o presentado, con los importes que su gestor ha dejado listos o presentados), qué modelos les corresponden este año y qué les pide su gestor, y para enviar a su gestor un mensaje de texto que ellos aprueban. Desde ChatGPT no se presenta, aprueba ni cambia nada; los archivos se envían desde el portal de Kuotia, el sitio recomendado también para los números de identidad y los datos bancarios.

Cobertura: península y Baleares en régimen común. No incluye Canarias, País Vasco, Navarra, Ceuta ni Melilla.
